forecasts.text: The February professional survey, before many of March’s disruptions, provides this outlook: The latest quarterly survey’s middle forecast expects about 2.1% growth for the quarter after that survey, at an annual pace. That means the pace if one quarter’s change lasted a year; it is a forecast, not a guarantee.
